title: Toaster Jam
description:
Актуальное

Об игреToaster Jam is a fast paced breakfast themed arcade game with quirky puzzle elements which will test your reflexes and requires quick thinking. Guide a little carb-hungry toaster around spiky doughnuts and past angry forks to toast as many slices of bread as you can! Power up your toaster with coffee and jam boosts to complete levels faster and get higher scores.Features
★ 40+ levels to test your skills 
★ 3 endless obstacle courses
★ Built-in level editor with Workshop integration
★ Charming toaster skins to unlock
★ Steam Trading Cards
★ Steam Achievements

Coming Soon
★ More challenging levels
★ Workshop integration
★ Different game modesDeveloper
description_short: Fast paced breakfast themed arcade game with quirky puzzle elements
